report.explanation: Gateway telemetry is largely healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 78ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, and INFO/200 logs. Only one ERROR trace span (gateway->inventory, 941ms) exists, insufficient to establish a bounded root cause. Downstream service telemetry is absent, so no taxonomy candidate can be substantiated; hand off for downstream evidence.
